description:
Deactivate the user account 'audit-temp@dev.arkcase.com' and update their Job Title to 'Former Auditor'.

Scenario: The contract for 'Audit Temp' has ended. As an administrator, you must secure the system by disabling their access immediately and updating their record for audit purposes.

Steps:
1. Log in as arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com (Password: ArkCase1234!)
2. Navigate to the Admin module
3. Find the user 'Audit Temp' (audit-temp@dev.arkcase.com)
4. Change their status to Inactive/Disabled
5. Change their Title to 'Former Auditor'
6. Save the changes
